newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain seen buying pesetas -dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain seen buying pesetas -dealers.

text.p: The Bank of Spain was continuously buying pesetas versus marks in order to smooth the currency's depreciation on Monday, dealers said.
They added they had seen the central bank buying at different levels with small amounts since this morning.
"They are intervening but they do not have an aggressive stance," said a dealer in Madrid.
At around 1600 GMT the peseta was trading at around 84.95/5.00 per mark, after having hit a low at 85.03. It started this morning at around 84.58/60.
The central parity for the peseta in the European Monetary System is at 85.0718.
